sloka: अत्यद्भुतमिदं दिव्यं वपुषा युक्तमुत्तमम् ।कथं वा भगवता प्राप्तं कुतो वा केन वा हृतम् ।। ७.७६.४९ ॥
transliteration: atyadbhutamidaṁ divyaṁ vapuṣā yuktamuttamam ।kathaṁ vā bhagavatā prāptaṁ kuto vā kena vā hṛtam ।। 7.76.49 ॥

translations.english: Rama asked, "How was this extremely wonderful, divine, and excellent form obtained by your revered self, or from where, or by whom was it taken away?"
